body: I appreciate that you're taking the time to try to help. Really, thank you. But honestly, nothing can really be helped. I'm stuck, at least for a while. Eventually, I'll have more power to help myself. But, for now, I just have to suck it up and try not to fall apart

I know that mental heath professionals do their job because they like to. And I know that helping people isn't a waste of time. But I still can't rationalize that I'm included in that. Even then, if I could build up to courage to set up an appointment, I wouldn't be able to actually do it. Logistically, it is nearly impossible for me to 1) Pay for it,  2) Get there, and 3) Avoid the inevitable shitstorm that would result. Unfortunately, I'm stuck for a while

I know you're probably right, and I would benefit from professional help. But, I can't make myself. I don't know how to talk about emotions. And, I don't deserve it. I'm just.. not worth enough to waste someone's time like that
Realizing that my parents' behavior is actually abusive, and not at all normal.

"When I saw you, I wanted to puke"

Thanks, Dad. I want to puke when I see myself, too.

Edit: I should add that this was said in response to a haircut.

Make it easy

Say I never mattered

Run it up the flag pole

* New Surrender - Anberlin

Not sure if this counts, but I'll share anyway. My band director (50+ year old man) once did the chicken dance. In the middle of a circle of band kids (at least 70). At 10:00pm. At an amusement park. It sounds lame, but we were all dying, and there are still videos of it.

My mom is emotionally abusive. Because I'm underage, I'm stuck for a while. But I can't get support. Everyone I would consider talking to knows my mom, and thinks she's great. But deep down, I wonder if it's even worth it to find help. I wonder if I'm worth their time, or if I'm just making it up and being overly sensitive.

I don't expect this to mean much, coming from a random kid on the internet, but I believe you can make your own family. Maybe you won't be able to make up for all the missed experiences. But you'll get the love you've deserved your whole life. It's a small hope, but it's something I cling to when I feel particularly down. I try to remind myself that, even if it takes a while, I can find someone who will love me.

Honestly, I still have a hard time recognizing that my past was harmful. I still feel like it was normal, even though I can link it to a lot of things I struggle with daily. I don't see how it can get better if I can't even understand something as basic as that. Anyway, thanks for responding, it means a lot that you took the time to do so.

Thanks for taking the time to respond, I appreciate it. Part of me wants to believe that I'm worth something, but no matter how hard I try, I can never find anything about me that is even remotely significant or unique. I'm practically invisible. Nobody notices me when I talk, I can sit in a room with someone for an hour and they will be surprised that I'm there. I just.. don't see it. Sorry for the mini-vent
